# Ekjot Singh

> Founder & Lead Architect at Metanthropic. Systems programmer and AI researcher investigating the physics of intelligence, mechanistic interpretability, sparse autoencoder manifolds, and deterministic distributed infrastructure.

- Website: https://ekjot.me
- Canonical GitHub: https://github.com/ekjotsinghmakhija
- X / Twitter: https://x.com/ekjot_makhija
- Email: ekjotsingh.makhija@gmail.com
- Lab: Metanthropic (https://metanthropic.vercel.app)

## Core Research & Focus Areas
- **Mechanistic Interpretability & Safety**: Latent Logic Topology, Attention Refraction (M-NAAR), Chronometric Flux Gating (CFG), and Oblique-Guard latent geometry stabilization.
- **Sparse Autoencoders & Representation Learning**: Mitigating manifold collapse, disentangling kinetic vs potential model computation (KP-IDP).
- **Frontier Reasoning Models**: Arvi 20B (Sparse MoE reasoning model matching frontier efficiency) and MahenOCR (1B vision-language model).
- **Low-Level Systems & Distributed Infrastructure**: Object-relational engines (VostSQL), zero-polling PostgreSQL event triggers (pg_listen), high-performance memory management, and TCP-level networking.

## Selected Publications & Specifications
- [M-NAAR: Metanthropic Neural Ablation via Attention Refraction](https://ekjot.me/blog/unlearning-trilemma-m-naar): Resolves the Unlearning Trilemma via attention refraction rather than weight destruction.
- [Latent Logic Topology & Soundness-Aware Calibration (SAL)](https://ekjot.me/blog/latent-logic-topology): Operationalizing LLMs as engines of latent causal chains to solve the RLVR convergence paradox.
- [KP-IDP: Kinetic-Potential Information Disentanglement Protocol](https://ekjot.me/blog/kp-idp): Proves decodability != causality by distinguishing dark computation from phantom readouts.
- [Module 003-CFG: Chronometric Flux Gating](https://ekjot.me/blog/chronometric-flux-gating-cfg): Eliminates feature absorption and latent manifold collapse in Sparse Autoencoders.
- [Project Oblique-Guard](https://ekjot.me/blog/oblique-guard-latent-geometry): Treats adversarial jailbreak vulnerability as an interference lattice artifact of superposition.
- [Moral Bias in Finetuned LLMs](https://ekjot.me/blog/moral-bias-interpretability): Localizes the Knobe Effect moral asymmetry with Iso-Semantic Residual Injection (ISRI).
- [Arvi 20B Reasoning MoE](https://ekjot.me/blog/arvi-20b-moe-release): 20B sparse MoE (3.6B active params) with sub-50ms execution on consumer hardware.
- [MahenOCR: 1B Soundness-Aware VLM](https://ekjot.me/blog/mahenocr-vlm-architecture): End-to-end vision-language model with grounded token verification.

## Selected Systems & Open Source Projects
- **VostSQL**: Relational database engine built from scratch with custom query planner and disk pager (C/C++).
- **Chromabase**: High-density archive CLI encoding arbitrary binary filesystems into video frames (Rust).
- **httpfromtcp**: HTTP/1.1 protocol server engineered over raw TCP sockets without third-party frameworks (Go).
- **pg_listen**: High-frequency zero-polling PostgreSQL event interceptor using native libpq (C).
- **SIM8086**: Modular hardware emulator and disassembler for the Intel 8086 microprocessor (C++, Qt 6).
- **Wibes Check**: Forensic open-source web intelligence scanner (Next.js, TypeScript).
